claims.summary: A binary sum/product circuit with scalar oracle gates for any polynomial vanishing on the Boolean cube computes the same Boolean function after replacing all oracle gates by zero. Hence no universal constant-depth polynomial-size F2 oracle extraction from every nonzero polynomial in an r-minor ideal can produce a determinant of order floor(r^(1/3)), or any Frobenius power thereof: use f_r=det_r(X)(x_11^2+x_11), then apply the recorded binary determinant-function lower bound. This does not refute large-field, extension-constant or growing-depth versions.
